faults.line: Scout: "Inez behind with the Bureau. Seeing Okafor, door guard. Jumps at everything."
faults.problem: The scene runs 10 beats and ends on the Scout's read, but §10 allows the cutaway at most 3 beats and keeps the read for when the act lands, so as written it gives the result before Listen's 30 s have run.
faults.fix: Play only the first 3 beats as the cutaway and deliver the rest, including this line, as bubbles when Listen lands.

faults.line: Inez: "One call, no letter. I never forget a face that didn't pay."

faults.fix: Play only the first 3 beats as the cutaway and deliver the rest, including this yes, as bubbles when Pressure lands.
